Good afternoon. I wrote up some notes on laying out the collection d-word. The desire is that the AI figures out laying out the dashboard. To start I think we take a simple approach and the frontend determines how to layout the dashboard based on a set of predetermined criteria. At a minimum we define the width and height of visualization and fit them on a grid. We can then add features likes prefer to add KPIs to the top of the dashboard, etc…

In the future we can look at using AI to help categorize content on the screen in more logical groupings.

Just wanted to give Max some kudos 👏 There is a backstory, but I was wondering could I use ChatGPT to generate simple synthetic data to power visualizations that tell a high level business story.  Earlier I shared with him the problem and he had an idea to leverage viz service with a new tool to generate synthetic data and I provided the vibes 🍄 ☀️ 🍃 🌈 ☮️ and a little bit of luck….

And we got something that kinda worked!?  I assumed this was going to be a lot more involved than it was. Is it perfect not at all, but I’m thinking this could end up being valuable now that I have an idea what to do.
